title: Concept: Gemfile entry with no version requirement
description: Gemfile declares a gem declared with no version requirement, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Bundler resolves the newest release, so a gem published after review installs with no change to the Gemfile.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: Bundler resolves the newest release, so a gem published after review installs with no change to the Gemfile.
